reviews.title: Good fan
reviews.comment: Fan looks great and it's pretty quiet. Easy to install and make sure you have the NZXT control hub to control the RGB (Some cases like the H5 elite provide it). You could barely hear it even when it's running at max rpm and you would not hear it when you have your headphones on.
reviews.author: BryanS

reviews.title: Great Fan
reviews.comment: Quiet and pretty fan. RGB is uniform, Wish it was daisy chain-able so that’s why I only gave it 4 stars.
